core_obligations: Reduce to a local situation (proof lines 12119-12138): using the covering lemma for morphisms of sites, find a covering {U_i -> U} and maps U_i -> u(V_i), then reduce to C/U_i and D/V_i by relocalisation and the commutative diagram for localising a morphism of ringed sites; hence assume D has a final object Y with X = u(Y) final in C.

Reduce to a strictly perfect witness for E (proof lines 12140-12153): take a covering {V_i -> Y} and strictly perfect complexes F_i with maps alpha_i to E|V_i whose cohomology is an isomorphism above m and a surjection in degree m, and localise again to assume a single strictly perfect F^bullet with such an alpha over D.

Push everything through Lf^* (proof lines 12154-12170): form the distinguished triangle F^bullet -> E -> C -> F^bullet[1]; the assumption on alpha says exactly H^j(C) = 0 for j >= m, so applying Lf^* gives a distinguished triangle with H^j(Lf^*C) = 0 for j >= m by the vanishing property of the left derived functor; hence H^j(Lf^*alpha) is an isomorphism for j > m and a surjection for j = m.

Conclude with strict perfectness of the witness (proof lines 12171-12174): since F^bullet is a bounded above complex of flat modules, Lf^*F^bullet = f^*F^bullet, and the strictly-perfect pullback lemma makes f^*F^bullet strictly perfect, so this is the required witness for Lf^*E, proving it is m-pseudo-coherent.
proof_roadmap: Localise along a covering of sites and of the site D to reach the case of final objects in both sites.
Choose a strictly perfect complex mapping to E with the pseudo-coherence conditions, localise to a single witness, and pull the resulting distinguished triangle back.
Use the vanishing of the derived pullback on the cone and the stability of strict perfectness under pullback to get a witness for Lf^*E.
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that m-pseudo-coherence is preserved by derived pullback along a morphism of ringed sites (statement lines 12109-12116). Its content is a two-stage localisation followed by one computation with a distinguished triangle (proof lines 12118-12174): the locality lemmas reduce to the case of final objects, a strictly perfect witness F^bullet -> E is localised to a single one, and after applying Lf^* the cone C with H^j(C) = 0 for j >= m must have H^j(Lf^*C) = 0 in the same degrees, which is the vanishing property of a left derived functor; strict perfectness of f^*F^bullet supplies the witness. H2: two reductions and one triangle computation, all written out.
